module/apps/xp-manager.js: One window class: its options, the context it renders with its fallback on an error, and its action handlers, which core calls as the class's own static #on<Action> members (foundry-patterns.md, Actions); rebuilding the XP history it shows is services/xp/versioning.js
module/config/design-gallery.js: The design gallery's fixture data, one entry per foundation token, component page, and pattern, read by its one window (module/apps/design-gallery.js); the samples of every section share one set of base contexts and rows, so the file splits by nothing but size
module/data/rules/rule-models.js: One registry of every rule model, split by nothing but size
module/services/dice/check/roll-check.js: rollCheck, the one roll pipeline, and the dialog it asks through: each step reads the values the steps before it set, from the request through the choices, the Void Points, the pool, and the TN to the posted message; the card it posts renders in card.js
module/sheets/base-actor-sheet.js: One base class of the PC and NPC sheets: the [data-action] delegation and the shared members each sheet's action switch calls, every one routed to a handler in module/sheets/handlers/
module/sheets/item-sheet.js: One sheet class: its options, parts, tabs, and context, and its action table; a set of actions one class uses stays as that class's static #on<Action> members (foundry-patterns.md, Actions), and the effect actions already delegate to ItemEffectsHandler in module/sheets/handlers/
module/utils/rule-engine.js: What each rule key produces (CLAUDE.md Layers): one output per key from validated rule data, the derived outputs in one pass over the rules; reading the finished bag is rule-bag.js
module/utils/rule-summary.js: The summary of every rule key: one line builder per key in RULE_KEYS and the phrase builders those lines share, split by nothing but size; the book citation is source-citation.js
